definitions.explanation: A circular object that rotates around an axle, used for transportation in vehicles.

examples.japanese: {車輪|しゃりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}っている→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車輪|しゃりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パンクした→パンク：10537_panku⟧。
examples.english: My bicycle wheel got a flat tire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車輪|しゃりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{線路|せんろ}→線路：04041_senro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: The train's wheels run on the tracks.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車輪|しゃりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (the wheel turns)
- ⟦{前輪|ぜんりん}→前輪：28610_zenrin⟧ (front wheel)
- ⟦{後輪|こうりん}→後輪：28611_kourin⟧ (rear wheel)
- ⟦{両輪|りょうりん}→両輪：28859_ryourin⟧ (both wheels; figuratively, two essential parts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧ - tire (the rubber part)
- ⟦ホイール→ホイール：28609_hoiiru⟧ - wheel (loanword, often for car alloy wheels)
- ⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ - ring, circle, wheel (general)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{両輪|りょうりん}→両輪：28859_ryourin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ように - like two wheels (= two essential complementary parts)
